home.badge: An gina shi da Stellar da USDC
home.subheadline: Aika kuɗi wanda yake ɓoye gaba ɗaya har sai lokaci ya yi. Ranakun haihuwa, tunawa, Ranar Val — sa kowace kyauta ba ta manta.
home.feature_escrow_desc: Ana ajiye kuɗi a kwangilar Soroban — ba wanda zai taɓa su har sai lokacin buɗewa ya yi.
home.feature_stable_desc: Ana ƙididdige kyaututtuka cikin USDC don haka adadin ba ya canzawa tsakanin aiko da ɗauka.
home.feature_fees_desc: Hanyar sauri ta Stellar na nufin ƙarin kuɗinka ya kai mai karɓa.
home.feature_ngn_desc: Biya da Naira ta Paystack. Masu karɓa na iya fitar da kuɗi kai tsaye zuwa asusun bankin Najeriya.
home.step1_desc: Shigar da lambar waya mai karɓa, adadin kuɗin Naira, da zaɓar ranar mamaki ta buɗewa.
home.step2_desc: Kammala biyan kuɗi ta Paystack ko kati. Ana canza kuɗi zuwa USDC kuma ana kulle su akan sarkar.
home.step3_desc: Suna karɓar SMS da ke gaya musu cewa kyauta tana jira — amma adadin yana ɓoye.
home.step4_desc: A daidai ranar da lokacin da ka zaɓa, ana bayyana kyautar kuma mai karɓa na iya ɗaukarta.
